title: Canonical bits from the final symbol
statement: For every Boolean word $w$, if its last symbol, interpreted as true when $w$ is empty, is true, then the binary expansion of the natural number whose binary digits are the symbols of $w$ read from right to left is exactly $w$.
hypotheses_covered: The last symbol of $w$, interpreted as true when $w$ is empty, is true
